messages:
maya (PM): quick idea — can we add persistent deploy presets to deploy-bot? I'm tired of retyping --dry-run + canary flags for every release

sam (SRE): +1. team-level presets would save time. ideally editable from repo or the console

jordyn (ENG): leaning repo-first: .deploy/presets.yml so CI + devs use same config. minimal syntax expected

leo (Release Lead): also want an automated fallback policy. if canary healthcheck fails, fallback to a pinned version or pause rollout and notify

maya (PM): rough UX: `/deploy --preset=canary-fast --dry-run` => bot posts a preview plan. when happy: `/deploy --preset=canary-fast --auto-fallback=pin:release-2026-03`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: got it — dry-run mode will simulate the rollout and list affected services. add `--auto-fallback` to annotate a fallback action. Example preview: 10% -> 33% -> 66% -> 100% with healthcheck hooks

sam (SRE): what's the presets file look like? short example pls

jordyn (ENG): simple YAML snippet:```yaml
# .deploy/presets.yml
canary-fast:
  rollout_percent: [10, 33, 66, 100]
  pause_seconds: 120
  health_checks:
    - /health/live
    - /health/ready
  notify: [#eng-oncall, #release-alerts]
full-dryrun:
  dry_run: true
  notify: [#release-dryrun]
```

nina (QA): can the bot also generate a release-notes draft from the preset? would help QA check what changes will hit prod in each stage

maya (PM): yes — include a release note template that pulls last changelog entries + PR titles. example snippet for bot:```yaml
release_note_template: "Release {{version}}: {{short_summary}}\n- PRs: {{pr_list}}\n- Rollout: {{preset_name}}\n- Fallback: {{fallback_action}}"
```

leo (Release Lead): operational detail: auto-fallback should be gated. default = manual. set `--auto-fallback=on` only for low-risk infra; otherwise `--auto-fallback=pin:<version>` and bot pauses + posts approvals needed

sam (SRE): on the implementation side, I'd add an idempotent dry-run mode in the bot code path + a preview webhook so CI can assert no surprises. Also add a `presets list` and `presets apply` subcommands

jordyn (ENG): agree. API surface: `/deploy preset create|update|delete|list` and `--preset=` flag. store file in repo or per-team via console JSON blob

maya (PM): timeline idea: small RFC PR this sprint, prototype in staging next sprint. who wants to pick up the RFC?

leo (Release Lead): I'll draft the rollout/fallback policy section and add canary thresholds

jordyn (ENG): I'll wire the CLI flags and preseting parsing, plus doc comments

sam (SRE): i'll stub healthcheck hooks and the preview webhook. will need a short integration test

nina (QA): i'll prepare test cases for rollout failure scenarios and confirm release-note generation

maya (PM): sweet. aim to ship RFC by Thu. thx all :tada:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: noted: creating issue `infra/deploy-presets` and assigning to leo, jordyn, sam, nina, maya. Preflight checklist: presets schema, CLI flags, dry-run idempotency, fallback docs.
